notes.title: Leaderboard Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hello everyone. There has been a bug that some people have been experiencing with the leaderboard. It would crash in certain occasions. If you have been experiencing this, we have a fix that is live in testing format. 

If you have not activating something like this on Steam before, right click on Fortix 2 in your Steam Library page > go to properties > betas > opt in through the drop box provided. The password, if you need one, should be: fortix

The full release should go live after we get some data make sure its fixed everywhere.

notes.title: Twice The Bundle, Twice The, Uh, Fundle
notes.content:
Don’t forget in these crowdsourced times that indie bundles remain very much a going concern. If anything, the huge success of the latest Humble Bundle (alright it might be only semi-indie, whatever, don’t be boring) means focus might once again turn to pay-what-you-want, publisher-free collections. Two more have turned up in recent days. IndieGala’s latest contains both PC and Android versions of some right little RPG and strategy crackers, while Indiefort’s second volley has a more fixed price for a selection of higher-tech PC games. Details below you may find, yes.*

notes.title: Nemesys Games is hosting for this years Global Game Jam!
notes.content:
For those that are in game development professionally or as a hobby, now is the time for you!  Nemesys Games is hosting a venue for this years Global Game Jam!  So those that want to get together for some fun this weekend, the event starts January 27th - 29th.  You can find more information on the event here:  

http://www.nemesys.hu/Global-Game-Jam-12

If you have any questions or would like to RSVP for the even please notify zach@nemesys.hu

notes.title: Fortix 2 Updated
notes.content:
Update notes:
- Fixed start up crashes in some rare cases (mostly caused by custom windows skins)
- Added support for Xbox360 controllers
- Added forced v-sync to the render to resolve video card overheating issue experienced by some user

notes.title: Want YOUR AVATAR in the game?
notes.content:
The player who will be #1 on the leaderboard exactly 2 weeks after the release hour (22:00 CET on 20 May 2011) will get to choose an avatar which will come out in the next update available to everybody. This is our way to immortalise your name and salute your achievement!

Tip: Check the updates regularly because we are planing on a map pack in the near future!
